scope: One installed bilingual renderer, an explicitly dependent course workflow, shared language-specific assets, native and structured authoring. Not universal language, printer or accessibility certification.

cases.expected_error: Column gap must not be negative
Can be used only in preamble

toolchain.language_packages: Official Debian texlive-lang-arabic and texlive-lang-french 2024.20250309-1; isolated format includes English, nohyphenation, French and Arabic.

review.independent_code_review: Completed; collision-free image names, safe dependency paths, compatible renderer API and CI dependencies verified.
review.limits: Author-level language reconciliation and actual-page inspection; no external human linguistic certification. First-page previews are browsing aids. Fonts/TeX packages remain external dependencies.
